interpretations: Include every customer, treating customers without invoices as having spent zero. Select customers whose revenue share exceeds the average share across all customers; report their mean total spend, mean share, and mean share minus that average share.
Apply the same all-customer threshold, but report the qualifying customers’ mean share excess relative to the average share: `(share / average share) - 1`.
Apply the same all-customer threshold, but use the mean invoice amount for qualifying customers as the spending figure; report the mean share and mean absolute share excess.
Apply the same all-customer threshold and mean invoice amount, but report relative share excess.
Consider only customers with invoices when calculating the average share and selecting customers above it; report their mean total spend, mean share, and mean absolute share excess.
Apply the invoiced-customer threshold, but report relative share excess.
Apply the invoiced-customer threshold, but use the mean invoice amount for qualifying customers as the spending figure; report the mean share and mean absolute share excess.
Apply the invoiced-customer threshold and mean invoice amount, but report relative share excess.
queries:
WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS spend
    FROM Customer AS c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
),
customer_shares AS (
    SELECT
        spend,
        1.0 * spend / NULLIF(SUM(spend) OVER (), 0) AS share,
        1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
    AVG(spend) AS mean_total_spend,
    AVG(share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(share - average_share) AS mean_share_above_average
FROM customer_shares
WHERE share > average_share

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Customer AS c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
),
shares AS (
    SELECT total_spent * 1.0 / SUM(total_spent) OVER () AS share
    FROM customer_totals
),
shares_with_average AS (
    SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(share / average_share - 1) AS mean_share_excess
FROM shares_with_average
WHERE share > average_share

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spending,
           AVG(i.Total) AS mean_invoice_amount
    FROM Customer AS c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT mean_invoice_amount
    FROM customer_spending
    WHERE total_spending > (SELECT AVG(total_spending) FROM customer_spending)
),
shares AS (
    SELECT mean_invoice_amount * 1.0
               / SUM(mean_invoice_amount) OVER () AS share,
           1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS equal_share
    FROM qualifying
)
SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share,
       AVG(ABS(share - equal_share)) AS mean_absolute_share_excess
FROM shares;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           AVG(i.Total) AS mean_invoice_amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spend
    FROM Customer AS c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
),
threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_spend) AS mean_customer_spend
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT cs.CustomerId,
       cs.mean_invoice_amount,
       cs.total_spend / t.mean_customer_spend - 1 AS relative_share_excess
FROM customer_spend AS cs
CROSS JOIN threshold AS t
WHERE cs.total_spend > t.mean_customer_spend

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total_spend
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY CustomerId
),
customer_share AS (
    SELECT total_spend,
           1.0 * total_spend / SUM(total_spend) OVER () AS share
    FROM customer_spend
),
shares_with_average AS (
    SELECT total_spend,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM customer_share
)
SELECT AVG(total_spend) AS mean_total_spend,
       AVG(share) AS mean_share,
       AVG(ABS(share - average_share)) AS mean_absolute_share_excess
FROM shares_with_average
WHERE share > average_share

WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spend
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(spend) AS average_spend
  FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT customer_spend.spend / benchmark.average_spend - 1 AS relative_share_excess
FROM customer_spend
CROSS JOIN benchmark
WHERE customer_spend.spend > benchmark.average_spend
